data.title: 圣女贞德 · 奥尔良乡野的草帽散步·「今天不是圣女，只是贞德小姐」
data.description: 【奥尔良乡间麦田小径·午后】卸下圣装的贞德换上白衬衫与宝蓝色长裙，头顶系带的麦秆草帽。她提着藤篮走在麦浪间的小径上，白皙的手指偶尔拂过麦穗尖端，被路过的农妇塞了一束雏菊便笑得眉眼弯弯。风吹起帽带与裙摆，那个背负法兰西的圣女，此刻只是一个在故乡阳光里散步的姑娘。
data.action: 一臂提稳装着雏菊的藤篮，另一手拂过麦穗，沿小径微笑行走
data.lighting: 温暖通透的夏日午后阳光，麦浪反光柔和
data.camera: medium full shot, walking with basket, pastoral golden fields, gentle smile
data.promptProse: Jeanne walks the wheat-field lane with daisies tucked into the wicker basket in one arm and her free hand brushing grain tips. White lace-collared blouse, long royal-blue skirt and ribbon-tied straw hat retain the countryside outfit beside her golden braid. The horizontal medium-full view follows the path through rolling wheat. Warm afternoon sun catches basket weave and wheat heads, while the hat gently shades her smiling eyes.
